title: Unit 7
text: 1 The cardboard box got to a recycling centre.
2 The cardboard box got on a truck.
3 The cardboard box became a book.
4 The cardboard box made friends with plastic cups, plastic bottles and glass bottles.
5 The cardboard box got to a house.
6 The cardboard box went into a machine.
What will the book become? Think and continue the story.
Now I'm old and broken. Will they throw me away? ...
Discuss with your partner. List three things you can do with a cardboard box. Then share your ideas with your classmates.
